senses.gloss: to make someone unable to stop using or doing something

senses.gloss: a person who cannot stop using or doing something harmful or enjoyable

example_translations.zh_TW: 該計畫為毒癮者提供支援。

definition_translations.zh_TW: 無法停止使用或做有害或令人愉快之事的人
